articles.headlineTranslated: Shocking incident in Nakhon Ratchasima! A second rabies victim, a 36-year-old man, was scratched by a stray cat and had not been vaccinated. He ultimately died. The Provincial Public Health Office warns the public not to be complacent, as even minor wounds can be life-threatening. - topnews.co.th
